Pathweft 7-Zip managed interop dependency

SharpSevenZip source: 9b2379be603a9d4ebff06c56944f87f0c623f8db
https://github.com/JeremyAnsel/SharpSevenZip/tree/9b2379be603a9d4ebff06c56944f87f0c623f8db
This is the source commit embedded in NuGet SharpSevenZip 2.0.130 metadata.
Copyright Markovtsev Vadim, Joel Ahlgren, Jeremy Ansel and contributors.
License: LGPL-3.0-or-later; preserve LICENSE.txt and upstream attribution.

Pathweft builds this source as 2.0.130-pathweft.1. The only source behavior change
is empty-directory.patch: accept the documented null directory marker during
stream validation, timestamp callbacks and native stream requests. This fixes an
observed native archive creation failure without dropping empty directories.
The same patch closes file streams created by CompressFileDictionary in its own
finally block. The upstream stream callback deliberately borrows those streams;
without this ownership fix, ZIP append leaves input files locked after publication.
The native DLL supplied alongside it is separately pinned to official 7-Zip26.05;
the wrapper's bundled native binaries are not the Pathweft runtime dependency.

Reproduction: Get-S4InteropSources.ps1, Prepare-S4InteropDependency.ps1 and
Build-Development.ps1. Runtime manifest records original/patched source hashes,
patch hash and resulting library hash. The final delivery stage must include
matching complete source, this patch and build instructions with applicable
distribution materials. Selected .cs.txt files are reference text, not compiled
copies or a second runtime implementation.
